from cart import Cart


def test_empty():
    assert Cart().subtotal() == 0


def test_add():
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add("book", 10, 2)
    assert cart.subtotal() == 20


def test_accumulate():
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add("book", 10, 2)
    cart.add("book", 10, 1)
    assert cart.subtotal() == 30


def test_discount():
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add("book", 100)
    assert cart.total(20) == 80


def test_no_discount():
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add("book", 10)
    assert cart.total() == 10
